iota_5.method: a square: I = diag(alpha, -alpha), J = [[0, b], [1, 0]]

conventions.Up: N_{U_p}: U_p[x] = sum_j [x varpi_j], varpi_j = iota^-1 [[5, j], [0, 1]]
conventions.characters: chi-part = {x in C[S_s]: <d>x = chi(d)x} for the homological adelic <d>; chi(2) = exp(2 pi i k/phi(5^s)) has Conrey label 2^k mod 5^s; the rows group chi by m = order of chi(2)
conventions.diamond: adelic <d>[x] = [x iota^-1 diag(1, d)] (v -> d^-1 v); tex: adelic <d> = classical <d>^-1; matrix stored for d = 2 (generator of (Z/5^s)^x)
conventions.matrices: homological, columns = images: M[t][c] = coeff of [x_t] in T[x_c]; function-side operator has matrix M^T
conventions.pi: pi_* = pushforward Z[S_{s+1}] -> Z[S_s]; pi^! = transpose of the trace on functions
conventions.points: x = k in GL_2(Z_5) at 5 <-> O^x-orbit of v = e_2 k^{-1} mod 5^s (lower row of k^{-1}); left action gamma: v -> v iota(gamma)^{-1}

provenance.notes: S01-C5: N_{U_p} and U'_p on S_1, S_2 (S_3 for the pi-checks)
